text: Figure 4.3: Trusted Execution Environment Architecture TEEs provide additional assurances such as isolation between multiple applications within the TEE, secure boot, the provision of state-of-the-art cryptographic toolbox [28], and access control over hardware peripherals. TEEs support different chipset architectures and different uses of Hypervisors. Figure 4 shows more details about a flexible TEE-based architecture.
